content:
Alex: PTAL — pushed a tiny change to the rate-limiter to handle short bursty clients. Addressed Maria's review: removed complex token refill math, added simple jittered backoff and a small unit test. CI passed locally but cloud smoke flaked once. Can someone do a quick sanity and/or queue a canary slot?
Maria: looking now, thanks. main thing I asked for was clearer log text + one extra edge test, I see both.
Sam: will run a perf quick-pass; curious about tail latency for 1k requests/s bursts.
Jen: I can grab a 30m canary after lunch (14:30 PT). Want me to reserve a slot?
CI Bot: build/1751236789-6 succeeded — unit, lint, basic smoke. (link: https://ci.example.com/builds/1751236789) :white_check_mark:
Alex: thanks. quick smoke command if useful:
```
# run short burst smoke
tools/smoke-runner --target-rate 1000 --burst-window-ms 200 --duration 30s --endpoint https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Alex: also added a tiny regression test for burst_window_ms edgecase (file: limiter_test.go).
Maria: ran the smoke against the staging lane — no obvious failures, p95/99 within 5% of baseline. left one tiny nit about a log string ("rate_limit" -> "rate-limited").
Sam: perf quick-pass: tail latency spikes are unchanged vs main branch on my run. nothing alarming.
Alex: pushed fix for log wording and rebased. thanks @Maria.
Maria: LGTM from me now. :thumbsup:
Jen: reserved canary 14:30-15:00 PT in the ops calendar, tagging ops-runbook. I'll watch and roll back if error rate > 0.5%.
Sam: quick question — did you keep the old refill threshold for compatibility?
Alex: yes, I left threshold default but added a flag `burst_window_ms` so infra can tune without a deploy. documented in the PR description.
Sam: cool, LGTM from perf side.
Alex: great, I'll merge after the canary run completes clean. Thanks everyone for quick eyes.
Maria: nice iterative cleanup.
CI Bot: deploy/canary started for build/1751236789 at 1751236801.
Jen: canary looks healthy at +5m, no errors, load steady.
Alex: merging now, will follow up if anything pops. :pray:
